test.create_query: CREATE TABLE enum16_map ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() AS SELECT CAST(mapFromArrays(arrayMap(i -> (number + i * 11) % 2000, range(200)), range(200)), assumeNotNull((SELECT 'Map(Enum16(' || arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(i -> '''ProfileEvent_SomeMetricName' || toString(i) || ''' = ' || toString(i), range(2000)), ', ') || '), Int64)'))) AS m FROM numbers(200000)
CREATE TABLE enum16_plain ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() AS SELECT arrayJoin(mapKeys(m)) AS e FROM enum16_map
test.query: SELECT CAST(e AS LowCardinality(String)) FROM enum16_plain FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT CAST(m AS Map(LowCardinality(String), Int64)) FROM enum16_map FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
